# Writz Protocol

> Writz is a lending protocol on Stellar backed by native BTC. A Bitcoin Script holds the collateral on Bitcoin itself rather than a company, and it never becomes a wrapped token. Borrow USDC against it, repay on your own schedule, and recover your Bitcoin even if Writz disappears. Live on Stellar testnet.

Every position is public on chain. Writz has no token.

## Official links

- [Website](https://writz.xyz): the official site
- [Docs](https://docs.writz.xyz): how Writz works, products, security model, developer reference
- [Docs for AI agents](https://docs.writz.xyz/llms.txt): the documentation index
- [Testnet app](https://testnet.writz.xyz): test BTC and test USDC, no real funds
- [GitHub](https://github.com/WritzProtocol/writz): source code, Apache 2.0
- [X](https://x.com/WritzProtocol): the official account
